# Zscaler Threats Overview â€” ASIM parity

Normalized Zscaler Internet Access telemetry delivered exclusively through Cribl. Lineage: `Azure/Azure-Sentinel` commit `cd455a8cecf3e5e983f9cd08191dca3d211c9fa1`, `Solutions/Zscaler Internet Access/Workbooks/NSSWebLogsThreats.json`. Vendor-specific values are read from documented `AdditionalFields` keys; select a time range and workspace below.

content.query:
_Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventProduct has 'ZIA'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields['LogType']) =~ 'NSSWeblog'
| where EventResult =~ 'Failure' and isnotempty(ThreatName) and ThreatName !in~ ('None','suspiciousfile')
| summarize Count=count() by ['Threat name']=ThreatName,threatname=ThreatName
| order by Count desc
content.title: Blocked threats

content.query:
_Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventProduct has 'ZIA'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields['LogType']) =~ 'NSSWeblog'
| where EventResult =~ 'Failure' and isnotempty(ThreatName) and ThreatName !in~ ('None','suspiciousfile') and ('{threatname}' == 'All' or ThreatName == '{threatname}')
| summarize Count=count() by bin(TimeGenerated,{TimeRange:grain}),['Threat name']=ThreatName
content.title: Blocked threats over time

content.query:
let data=materialize(
_Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventProduct has 'ZIA'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields['LogType']) =~ 'NSSWeblog'
| where EventResult =~ 'Failure'
| where isnotempty(DstGeoCountry)
| extend MaliciousIPCountry=DstGeoCountry,Activity=coalesce(tostring(AdditionalFields['Action']),EventResultDetails));
let countryData=data
| summarize TotalCount=count() by MaliciousIPCountry
| join kind=inner (data | make-series Trend=count() default=0 on TimeGenerated in range({TimeRange:start},{TimeRange:end},{TimeRange:grain}) by MaliciousIPCountry) on MaliciousIPCountry
| extend Id=strcat('country-',hash_sha256(MaliciousIPCountry)),Name=MaliciousIPCountry,Type='Location',ParentId=''
| project Id,Name,Type,['MaliciousIPCountry Count']=TotalCount,Trend,ParentId;
let activityData=data
| summarize TotalCount=count() by MaliciousIPCountry,Activity
| join kind=inner (data | make-series Trend=count() default=0 on TimeGenerated in range({TimeRange:start},{TimeRange:end},{TimeRange:grain}) by MaliciousIPCountry,Activity) on MaliciousIPCountry,Activity
| extend Id=strcat('action-',hash_sha256(strcat(MaliciousIPCountry,'|',Activity))),Name=Activity,Type='Activity',ParentId=strcat('country-',hash_sha256(MaliciousIPCountry))
| project Id,Name,Type,['MaliciousIPCountry Count']=TotalCount,Trend,ParentId;
union activityData,countryData
| order by ['MaliciousIPCountry Count'] desc,Name asc
content.title: Blocked destination activities, by location
